minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  August 23, 2022

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Crosby at 6:30 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, Chair – Council Member
  Wendy Lau, Council Member
  Denise Fisher, Resident

  Don Kendrick, Resident
  Chris Dransfeldt, LVPD
  Ryan, Lehotsky, LVPD
  Janessa Gonzalez, LVPD
  Isela Moreno, Tri-City Mental Health
  Paulina Ale, Tri-City Mental Health
  Mark Rodgers, BUSD
  Joy Lindsay, BUSD
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne
  Ron Serven, LVSDEF/Resident
  Alfie Sanchez, Majestic Cycling
  Kathy Sanchez, Majestic Cycling

3. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the June 28th meeting were not approved
  due to lack of present Executive Board members and
  will be considered at the next meeting.

4. Introduction  The group was formally introduced to newly
  appointed Executive Board Member Wendy Lau who
  is serving as a City Council representative.

5. Executive Board Vacancy  JR Ranells with the City shared that only one
  application for the remaining vacant Executive Board
  position had been received and it was from long time
  YFAC participant Don Kendrick. The group
  unanimously voted to recommend Don for formal
  approval by the City Council at their next meeting.

6. SRO Report  School Resource Officer Janessa Gonzalez reported
  that the first couple of days of school went smoothly.
  Janessa also shared that her and the high school
  staff have a positive professional relationship. The
  group discussed the increase in traffic safety
  measures in place for the next couple of weeks.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes August 23, 2022, page 2

  Tobacco Education Compliance Officer Ryan
  Lehotsky provided an update on flavored tobacco
  enforcement efforts and noted their positive impacts
  in the community.

7. BUSD Report  Mark Rodgers with the BUSD shared information
  about the universal transitional kindergarten program.
  Mark also noted information about the enhanced
  mental health services provided by the district.

  Lastly, Mark shared that Superintendent Coles had
  resigned but the district was in good shape and good
  hands.

8. Suicide Prevention  Isela Moreno and Paula Ale with Tri-City Mental Health
  Services shared information about the Community
  Navigator Program. They also noted that September
  was Suicide Prevention Awareness Month and shared
  information and resources for the group and
  community.

9. Public Comment  Chair Crosby shared information about the Christmas
  Morning Program and possible ideas for volunteers.

  Alfie Sanchez shared information about the Bike
  Program and beginning to plan for this year’s program.

  Ron Serven shared information regarding the La
  Verne/San Dimas Education Foundation and available
  resources as well as information on the Ramona
  Middle School Wellness Garden.

  Mark shared information regarding the Smudge Pot
  game taking place on September 10th.

10. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for
  September 27, 2022.

11. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:24 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Assistant City Manager
